name: Ammonia as marine fuel
principle: Ammonia burns in dual-fuel engines on ships. IEA reports that 4-stroke ammonia engines are commercially available for smaller vessels, 2-stroke engines for large ships are not yet commercial, and more than 30 ships are on order with deliveries from late 2025. IMO amended the IGC Code in December 2024 to permit ammonia cargo as a marine fuel, in force July 2026. IEA rates ammonia-fuelled ship engines at TRL 6.
